usedFor: Postify turns each new Shopify listing into a social post, planned for the channels you pick.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in Postify
bestTemplate.why: The post can be a draft, scheduled or live, which is the most direct way to announce a product.

watchOut: “Reschedule Post” only moves a post Postify already has, so it cannot be what a Shopify event starts.
